viewing_check: Check the size of the break top right and how much face enamel is lost, edge chips and fixing holes, and the rust on the back. Look for any Tasmania-specific maker mark. Photograph the 'Made in England' mark and the reverse. Possible Tasmanian collector premium over UK signs, but the Gowans results (A$40 to A$130 recent, A$2,860 in 2024) are very mixed, so check what that A$2,860 piece was.
